questions.stem: Why is the rapid growth of the human population a concern for the environment?

options.text: It has no impact because technology can solve all problems
It leads to increased use of resources, more waste, and greater pollution
It decreases the demand for fossil fuels
More people means more oxygen is produced

questions.explanation: A rapidly growing human population places greater demand on resources (food, water, land, energy), produces more waste and pollution, and leads to more habitat destruction. These all negatively impact ecosystems and biodiversity.
